title: Planar Contact Structures with Calabi-Yau Fillings and Topological Quantum Computation
summary: We study planar openbooks obtained by lifting braids through branched covers of D^2, together with the quantum operations in the Ising representation. We give a criterion for the Stein fillings to be Calabi-Yau (CY). Among positive factorizations of a fixed monodromy, a CY one has minimal length and its filling minimizes χand b_2. Applied to Baykur's recent examples, this gives a planar contact 3-manifold with infinitely many non-homeomorphic CY fillings, the cover there having degree \ge 6. At degree 4 a single CY filling forces every filling to be CY, and in one case the filling is unique;…
